exceptions.reason: Expo, Jest and ESLint still resolve the legacy CommonJS API. Forcing brace-expansion 5 across those dependency contracts is a breaking transitive override.
exceptions.compensation: No server request path or shipped application bundle invokes glob expansion; CI passes only repository-owned paths and patterns.

exceptions.scope: Metro bundler, build time only (@crowdsource/console and @crowdsource/reviewer)
exceptions.reason: No fixed version of image-size exists. The advisory covers <=2.0.2 and 2.0.2 is the latest published release on every dist-tag (latest 2.0.2, legacy 1.2.1), so an override has nothing to point at; metro 0.84.4 pins ^1.0.2 in any case. The only real-dependency path is react-native > @react-native/community-cli-plugin > metro > image-size, entered exclusively by the two Expo app workspaces.
exceptions.compensation: Denial of service through an infinite loop in the ICNS parser, reachable only by parsing a hostile image. Metro reads image dimensions at bundle time from repository-owned assets; no server request path, no published package, and no shipped app bundle parses image bytes with it. @crowdsource/backend reaches image-size only through @oxyhq/core's optional peer @react-native-async-storage/async-storage, which the backend does not install as a dependency and never loads.
